notes.title: Update Notes For Feb 29
notes.content:
Hello there! This is Callmerat Games.

I have some improvements related to Stage 11 of Urban Chase.

1.Bug Fixes

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the thief wasn't hit when firing the taser gun.
[*] Addressed an issue where the position of the police car was distorted as the game progressed.
[/list]
2.Balance Adjustments

[list]
[*] Increased the taser gun ammo capacity from 10 rounds to 20 rounds.
[*] Lowered the arrest condition for thieves from 10 to 7.
[/list]
3.User Interface Enhancements:

[list]
[*] Revised the initial guidance for clarity
[/list]
A big thank you to the police officer who provided feedback.

If you have any feedback or questions regarding this update, please feel free to contact us at [callmeratgames@gmail.com].

Thank you. The safety of the urban is in your hands, commitment!

Best regards,
Callmerat Games

notes.title: This Week in Urban Chase
notes.content:
Hello, this is Callmerat Games.
I will continue to make efforts to ensure passionate experiences for our police officers.

Here are the details of this update:

[list]
[*] Added sparkling effect to the cola given by citizens to increase visibility.
[*] Resolved congestion issues with citizen traffic.
[*] Adjusted thief behavior to require getting closer to catch when they are hiding.
[*] Added speed boots to Stage 9.
[/list]
Thank you. The safety of the urban is in your hands, commitment!
